contexts.text: The root is dried up () = charity cannot bear fruit.
That nothing of the good and truth of faith could yet take root. Signified.

Then first are the truths of faith rooted. Explained. Rooting never begins until the man receives the good of charity. All the truth of faith is rooted by the good of faith... So a seed does not take root until the heat of the sun warms the earth... then the seed begins first to push its root within itself, and afterwards to send it forth into the ground. So spiritual seed... is never rooted until the good of charity warms it: then first it pushes its root within itself, and afterwards sends it forth.
They have no root in themselves () = no charity, for in this faith is rooted; and those who do not enjoy this root, yield in temptations.
Leave them neither root nor branch () = neither charity nor Truth.
Can send a root no deeper than the thought.
To kill the root with famine, etc. () = to take away the goods and truths which had been stored up interiorly by the Lord.
The Lord inflows... with good and truth: their root must be in the inmost...
Such is the rooting of faith.
The seed, which is interior good and truth, cannot be rooted except in exterior good and truth as soil.
Affections are rooted... in man by his life.
(Thus) no truth can be implanted with genuine affection, and interiorly rooted, unless the man is in good.
This root (hereditary evil) lies deeply hidden.
Reflect, whether the truth which is of faith can be rooted except in good, and whether faith, unless rooted there, is faith.
The proprium, radically, is evil.

Until nothing (of the truths and goods of the Church) is left in the internal and the external of man, is signified by, it will leave them neither root nor branch. The root of good and truth is in the internal of man, and the branch is in the external.
The Root of Jesse () = the Lord from whom is this good. AE 175:6. AE 205:6.
Lest this worst root of evils be excited with them.

(Thus) the Truth of the Word cannot be rooted with those who do not care for the Truth; nor with those who love the Truth exteriorly (only); nor with those who are in the concupiscences of evil; but with those with whom the concupiscences of evil have been dispersed by the Lord: with these the seed is rooted, that is, the Truth in their spiritual mind.

As this proprium of man constitutes the first root of his life, it is evident what kind of a tree a man would be, unless this root were extirpated, and a new root implanted... This root is not removed, and a new one implanted in its place, unless the man regards the evils which constitute the root as things hurtful to his soul, and therefore wants to banish them...
He who combats acts from the interior, and against the concupiscence itself, which constitutes the root of evil... (Thus) the root of evil is not removed except by combat.
With the merely natural, the root of evil remains implanted.
This endeavour is continuous from the earths through the root even to the ultimates...
Vegetations take place through the barks, by pushing through the envelopes of the roots...
Avarice is the root (or a root) of evils.

All truth is sown in the internal man, and rooted in the external, and therefore unless the sown seed is rooted in the external man, which is done by acting, it becomes like a tree planted not in but on the soil... This root the man carries with him after death who has done Truths; but not the man who has only Known them.
Of the tribe of Judah the root of David () = through Divine good united to Divine truth in His Human.
I am the root and the Offspring of David () = that He is the Lord Himself, who was born in the world, thus the Lord in His Divine Human. From this he is called the root and Offspring of David...
Like the root of a tree in the earth (which grows again).
When the earth is first opening a seed, it begins from the root, which is like a heart, and sends out from it the sap, which is like blood...
This radical evil would at once burst out... WE 5486. WE 5593. WE 5606. WE 5687.
Like the derivation of the roots of a tree in the earth; or like a glandulous root which is rooted inwardly... Evils are the tares which strike broad roots, and oppress the roots of the good seed.
Therefore, unless they are the Truths of faith, they cannot be rooted; but they are the roots of the tares which oppress them, but still cannot extirpate them...
For then the roots do not work down deeply. SE 1439.
Thus there is a root...
The roots () = knowledges.

The root of David = the Divine truth... The Lord as to the Human is called the root of David, from the fact that everything of Divine truth is from Him, as also all things come forth and subsist from their root. Hence, too, it is, that He is called the root of Jesse.
To kill the root with famine = to completely perish from there being no good: the root = everything from which it lives.
The root of the serpent () = that false beginning or principle. AE 727:21. (Compare AE 817:9.)

It sendeth forth its roots beside the river () = the extension of intelligence from the spiritual man into the natural... for the roots are sent forth from the spiritual man into the natural. AE 518:12.
The second state of regeneration is signified by, he shall infix his roots (), which state is that of its coming forth in the Natural; for there the roots are fixed.
Thou hast caused its roots to take root () = instruction according to order, namely... that they are introduced into the Church.
The root = the first thereof.

To inflow into the interiors of the mind (as the Lord does), and through them into its exteriors, is to infix the root, and to produce from the root: the root is in the interiors, and production in the exteriors.

As the Lord is not dead, there remains, according to Daniel, a root in the earth... That which remains is the faculty of being able to understand truth and to will good. This is the root that remains.
